source.label: BetterPlaridel editors
source.notes: The first six are the most requested; the home page lists them as "Popular services".

services.title: Civil Registry
services.body: Birth, marriage and death certificates, and late registration.

services.title: Business Permits
services.body: New and renewal business permits, and requirements checklist.

services.title: Cedula
services.body: Community Tax Certificate for employment, permits and transactions.

services.title: Real Property Tax
services.body: Amilyar payment schedule, discounts and tax declarations.

services.title: Health Services
services.body: Rural Health Unit, vaccinations, check-ups and health programs.

services.title: Social Welfare
services.body: MSWDO assistance, senior citizen, PWD and solo parent IDs.

services.title: Jobs (PESO)
services.body: Job fairs, local hiring and employment assistance.

services.title: Barangay Directory
services.body: Find your barangay hall, officials and contact details.
